notes.title: Mystic Gate update Ver. 1.1.0 is now available!
notes.content:
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/42658803/dca7db5e2d5864c3d4e19f73bba421f1fa75bb3f.png[/img]

Thank you for playing Mystic Gate!
Mystic Gate update Ver. 1.1.0 is now available!

[h2]Addition of difficulty levels[/h2]
The following difficulty levels have been added:

[h3](1) HARD[/h3]
A difficulty level for players accustomed to action.
It can be selected from the beginning.
[list][*]Enemies are strengthened
[*]The number of enemies appearing is increased
[*]Shop prices are increased
[*]The amount of gems obtained when defeating bosses is increased[/list][h3](2) DESPAIR[/h3]
The highest difficulty level for players who are not afraid of death.
It can be selected by clearing NORMAL or HARD.
[list][*]Enemies are further strengthened
[*]The number of enemies appearing is further increased
[*]Shop prices are further increased
[*]The amount of gems obtained when defeating bosses is further increased[/list]
[h2]Addition of new achievements to the adventurer's association[/h2]
※Not linked with Steam achievements
[olist][*]Two new achievements have been added[/olist]
[h2]Improvements[/h2]
The following improvements have been made:
[olist][*]Improved the visibility of some enemy bullets
[*]Improved the visibility of "Ghost"
[*]Improved the issue where "Werewolf" would get stuck in corners of rooms[/olist]
[h2]Bug fixes[/h2]
The following bug fixes have been made:
[olist][*]Fixed a bug where enemy bullets remaining on the screen after defeating "Goddess Of Trials - Form 1" would not disappear
[*]Fixed a bug where "Black Hole Gun" could not be fired immediately after switching weapons
[*]Fixed a bug where if the skill "Mark of Fire" and other status-altering skills were learned together, "Mark of Fire" would be applied preferentially
[*]Fixed a rare bug where "Ballistic Missile" could sometimes not be fired
[*]Fixed a bug where the game would freeze on the results screen
[*]Fixed a bug where active skills would sometimes not activate immediately
[*]Fixed a bug where using the dash during combat with the "Trader" while having learned the "Assault" skill would cause the trader health to recover[/olist]

notes.title: Ver 1.0.1 update!
notes.content:
[h2]Added functions and system updates[/h2]

[h3](1) Added the ability to adjust the sight scroll distance[/h3]
Added the ability to adjust the distance the camera scrolls in accordance with the sight movement.
This can be adjusted from [Settings] > [Aim Settings].

[h3](2) Added the ability to display silhouettes of characters behind walls.[/h3]
A function has been added to display silhouettes of characters who are behind walls and are not visible.
This can be toggled ON/OFF in [Settings].

[h3](3) Added the ability to skip endings[/h3]
You can now skip the ending after clearing the game for the second time.

[h3](4) Automatic collection of coins[/h3]
Changed to automatically collect coins dropped from enemies.
Dropped coins will now be automatically collected even if they are far away.

[h3](5) Elimination of enemy bullets when all enemies are killed[/h3]
When all enemies in a room are killed, remaining enemy bullets will now disappear.

[h3](6) Fixed pause screen UI[/h3]
When weapon information is displayed on the pause screen, the weapon description can now also be viewed.

[h3](7) Improved skill cooldown time UI[/h3]
The skill cooldown time UI has been improved.
We have also added a note to the help section, as it was not mentioned in the help section previously. 

[h3](8) Fixed the button navigation display[/h3]
When playing with a Keyboard & Mouse, the button navigation display switched to the gamepad display when a gamepad was connected, but this has been changed so that it does not switch.

[h2]Balance Adjustment[/h2]

[h3](1) Increased the number of Gems obtained[/h3]
Increased the number of gems dropped from treasure chests.
Increased the number of gems that drop when defeating bosses. 

[h3](2) Strengthened melee weapons[/h3]
[list][*][h3]Longsword[/h3]
Added the ability to knock down enemy bullets.
[*][h3]Laser Blade[/h3]
Added the ability to deflect enemy bullets.
[*][h3]Chainsaw[/h3]
Weapon attack motion has been adjusted.
[*][h3]Pile Bunker[/h3]
Increased range.
Reduced full reload time.[/list]
[h3](3) Adjustments to Player Skills[/h3]
[list][*][h3]Master of reloading[/h3]
Reduced weapon reload time.
[*][h3]Steel Spirit[/h3]
Increased the weapon's accuracy.
[*][h3]Recovery[/h3]
Increased attack power time after taking damage.
[*][h3]Lucky 7[/h3]
Greatly increased attack power rate.
[*][h3]Mark of Fire, Mark of Freeze, Mark of Poison, Mark of Binding, Mark of Flash[/h3]
Increased chance of occurrence.
[*][h3]Each master type skill (“handgun master” etc.)[/h3]
Increased attack power rate.[/list]

notes.title: Mystic Gate Update - Coming Soon!
notes.content:
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/42658803/b27409abaa3b41cf0388f2a218c824c10f84e9d7.png[/img]

Dear Mystic Gate players,

Thank you for playing Mystic Gate!
We will be updating Mystic Gate to make it even more effortless for you to play.

[list][*]In this update, we will increase the number of gems dropped, make it easier to acquire permanent skills and level up, and adjust the automatic collection of coins to allow you to focus on the enjoyable parts of the game.
[*]When all enemies in a room are destroyed, any remaining enemy bullets will disappear, so that the player(s) will not take damage after they complete a room.
[*]In some cases, we will improve the usability of melee weapons and review the effectiveness of passive skills.
[*]The UI will be changed to clearly indicate when active skills can be activated, and to allow the user to check the description of acquired weapons when they are equipped.
[*]Enable silhouette display to show the player's position even when the player is behind a wall, and adjust the sight scroll distance.
[*]In addition, we plan to optimize the operation UI guide and add the ability to skip endings.
[/list]
If you are new to Mystic Gate and found it difficult, this update is for you. Of course, it will also make gameplay more accessible for players who had no issues with the game, so stay tuned!

The update will be available soon, so please be patient.
*Please note that the content of the update is subject to change without notice.
